description: Source code for UpnpDiscoveryManager class handling UPnP device discovery via SSDP on Raspberry Pi 4. Includes context initialization, device discovery, callback handling, and telemetry logging.

classes.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager
classes.description: Manages UPnP device discovery using SSDP, handles context setup, device callbacks, and discovery timeout.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::UpnpDiscoveryManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing member variables and telemetry if enabled.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::~UpnpDiscoveryManager
methods.description: Destructor releasing resources and unrefing GObject references.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::initialiseUpnp
methods.description: Initializes GUPnP context and control point for device discovery on specified interface.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::logTelemetry
methods.description: Logs discovery events to telemetry system if enabled.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::discoveryTimeout
methods.description: Handles discovery timeout, stops search, logs 'Unknown' gateway, and exits wait loop.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::findGatewayDevice
methods.description: Starts SSDP discovery for InternetGatewayDevice on specified interface.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::on_device_proxy_available
methods.description: Callback invoked when SSDP reply is received, extracts device info, logs, and stops discovery.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::enterWait
methods.description: Enters GLib main loop to wait for device discovery events.

methods.name: UpnpDiscoveryManager::exitWait
methods.description: Exits GLib main loop after discovery completes or times out.
